picks.episode_title: Baby Jude’s Picks | Wed NBA Best Bets
picks.quote: Three star play on the night. Franz Wagner over 30 and a half points and assists.
picks.reason: Franz Wagner has been performing exceptionally well without Paulo and the 76ers' defense is slipping.
picks.description: Franz Wagner over 30.5 points and assists
picks.edge: Franz has been smashing this number time and time again; he's the only player in the league right now with at least 300 points and at least 100 assists.

picks.episode_title: Baby Jude’s Picks | Wed NBA Best Bets
picks.quote: We're going to be on Davion Mitchell over 21 and a half points plus assists.
picks.reason: Mitchell has been consistently scoring and assisting, especially against a weak Bucks defense.
picks.description: Davion Mitchell over 21.5 points plus assists
picks.edge: Davion has hit this in 12 of 14 games and the Bucks have abysmal defense.

picks.episode_title: Baby Jude’s Picks | Wed NBA Best Bets
picks.quote: This is just the heat total team over which I don't do a lot of total team overs, but...

picks.episode_title: Baby Jude’s Picks | Wed NBA Best Bets
picks.quote: Going with Giannis over twenty eight and a half points plus the Milwaukee Bucks plus twelve and a half.

rejected.quote: I have this number closer to six in terms of where we are with the Cavs and the Memphis Grizzlies. Anything that is south of five or at five at minus one ten is an absolute buy.

rejected.reason: The Cavaliers are expected to perform better against a weaker Memphis team missing a key player.
